projects.name: CareSync Mobile
projects.description: Pediatric therapy & clinic management Android application

test_cases.name: Crash & Memory Leak Monitoring
test_cases.description: Monitors Logcat for NullPointerExceptions, OutOfMemoryErrors, and background thread deadlocks.

test_cases.name: Network & API Resiliency
test_cases.description: Monitors API endpoints, latency metrics, and error rates during server timeout simulations.

test_cases.name: UI Exploration & Input Validation
test_cases.description: Navigates primary application views, forms, and input fields to detect layout overflows and unhandled null inputs.

test_cases.name: Authentication & Session Persistence
test_cases.description: Tests user login flow, invalid credentials rejection, and session token retention across app restart.

test_steps.expected_result: Activity state preserved without memory leak
test_steps.actual_result: NullPointerException thrown in FragmentStateAdapter on rotation
API latency spikes to 2450ms, triggering socket timeout warning

test_steps.action: Enter special characters in Search Bar (<script>alert(1)</script>)
test_steps.expected_result: Input sanitized, no crash or raw HTML execution
All widgets render without text clipping

test_steps.action: Input valid test credentials & tap Sign In
test_steps.expected_result: User authenticated, token stored in EncryptedSharedPreferences
test_steps.actual_result: HTTP 500 error returned from authentication backend on 3rd attempt

findings.title: NullPointerException Crash on Rapid Screen Rotation
findings.description: App crashes with NullPointerException in FragmentStateAdapter when user rapidly rotates device orientation between Portrait and Landscape.
findings.impact: Application forcibly terminates with crash popup, resulting in unsaved user state loss.
findings.expected_behavior: Activity should save fragment state in onSaveInstanceState and recreate smoothly.
findings.actual_behavior: Fatal Exception: java.lang.NullPointerException: Attempt to invoke virtual method on a null object reference at com.qa.app.ui.DashboardFragment.onViewCreated(DashboardFragment.java:142)
findings.reproduction_steps:
1. Open Dashboard screen
2. Trigger rotation shortcut 5 times rapidly
3. Observe Logcat stack trace and crash popup

findings.title: Authentication API HTTP 500 Internal Error during Session Verification
findings.description: During dynamic test execution of Authentication & Session Persistence, POST /api/v1/auth/login returned HTTP 500 status code upon 3rd login attempt.
findings.impact: Users cannot log in reliably, causing authentication failure and preventing access to main application features.
findings.expected_behavior: Authentication endpoint should handle repeated login attempts gracefully and return valid JWT or HTTP 401 on bad credentials.
findings.actual_behavior: Server returned HTTP 500 Internal Server Error with empty body.
findings.reproduction_steps:
1. Launch APK on Pixel 8 Android 15
2. Navigate to Login screen
3. Tap Sign In 3 times rapidly with valid credentials

findings.title: Hardcoded API Credential / Secret Key Discovered
findings.description: Static scan identified embedded sensitive secret: Google API Key (AIzaSy...) detected in binary.
findings.impact: Attackers can decompile the APK and extract secret API keys to impersonate your backend or abuse cloud API quotas.
findings.expected_behavior: Secrets should never be stored in APK binaries; use secure backend token exchange or Android KeyStore.
findings.actual_behavior: Hardcoded key pattern found in compilation DEX strings.
findings.reproduction_steps:
1. Decompile APK with apktool / jadx
2. Search strings for secret prefix

findings.title: Insecure Cleartext HTTP Traffic Allowed
findings.description: Unencrypted HTTP endpoints detected in APK binary: http://ns.adobe.com/xap/1.0/, http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#, http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/, http://ns.adobe.com/xap/1.0/g/img/, http://ns.adobe.com/xap/1.0/mm/, http://ns.adobe.com/xap/1.0/sType/ResourceRef#, http://ns.adobe.com/xap/1.0/sType/ResourceEvent#, http://ns.adobe.com/illustrator/1.0/.
findings.impact: Sensitive user data and auth tokens transmitted over cleartext HTTP can be intercepted via Man-in-the-Middle (MitM) attacks.
findings.expected_behavior: All network traffic must be encrypted over TLS/HTTPS.
findings.reproduction_steps:
1. Scan network endpoints
2. Observe HTTP traffic without TLS handshake
